curation.notes: Dual-trap optical tweezers (LUMICKS C-Trap) dumbbell assay on the synthetic doxycycline-binding RNA aptamer G12 (long-stem, short-stem and no-stem constructs) with 0.5 kb DNA handles; force-ramp and passive-mode (constant trap distance, HMM-analysed) measurements with and without doxycycline reveal a ligand-stabilised folding intermediate. Most of the paper is SELEX, NGS, ITC, fluorescence and cell-based riboswitch work; the provided methods text is truncated mid-way through the kon/koff analysis.
